body_markdown:
The holidays are right around the corner, and I couldn’t be more excited. I’m always intentional with decor this time of year, using warm lighting, colorful accents and holiday scents to make my place feel festive. And with all of the new game releases on the horizon, I’m turning my attention to the place I’ll likely spend most of my time: my gaming setup.


Lately, I’ve been trying to make my gaming setup feel cozier and reflect my hobbies, but one detail I previously overlooked was lighting. Ever since I upgraded my setup with mood lighting — whether it’s smart bulbs or customizable RGB on headsets, keyboards and mice — it has made spending time in my space so much more engaging.


[Research actually shows](https://www.nature.com/nature-index/topics/l4/impact-of-lighting-conditions-on-cognitive-performance) that adjusting your lighting’s color and brightness can boost your mood, focus and energy. By utilizing customizable RGB software, gamers can enjoy both the aesthetics of their desktop setup and a more immersive, comfortable experience during longer gaming sessions.


Here are my recommendations to help you, or the gamer on your list, dial in your setup to match your game style:


##


#### **Enchanted Forest Kingdom Vibes**


Step into a familiar mythical fantasy realm with a fresh, enchanted setup that brings pure forest tranquility. Even if your favorite open-world hero isn’t natively on PC, pairing custom keycaps and unique control dial with a keyboard brings that lush, iconic forest aesthetic straight to your desk.


- **[G-KEYCAPS (Forest)](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/g-keycaps-pbt-keycaps)** **:** Bring the forest right to your fingertips with green earthy tones that set a serene, adventurous mood for every quest.


- **[G316 X 75 (White)](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/g316-x-75-gaming-keyboard)** **:** A sleek, compact 75% mechanical keyboard that delivers an ultra-clean desk setup. You can easily customize it with our G-KEYCAPS and enhance it even further with 25 distinct RGB light zones on the interactive light bar!


- Use this lush forest green hex code #88d62f in the LIGHTSYNC RGB tab of G HUB and instantly transform your desk into an enchanted, forest-inspired adventure!


- **[G325 LIGHTSPEED headset](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/g325-lightspeed-headset)** **:** Channel your inner princess or evil doppelganger with our colorways Lilac, White, and Black. It’s lightweight, comfy, and tailored perfectly for your journey.


#### **Neon City Sunset Aesthetic**


Soak up the warm sun and chaotic heist filled nights with gear built for immersive audio and vibrant RGB customization.


- **[G522 LIGHTSPEED](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/g522-lightspeed)** **:** Powered by LIGHTSYNC RGB with around 16.8 million color options, it is super easy to customize your lighting in G HUB to match the iconic sunsets. PRO-G Audio drivers deliver punchier bass, so you won’t miss a single beat of the in-game radio and cinematic cutscenes.


- [G502 X PLUS (Black/Purple):](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/g502-x-plus-wireless-lightforce) The legendary G502 X Plus mouse comes in a new Black/Purple colorway that matches the sleek city mood.


- **[G512 X](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/g512-x-98-gaming-keyboard)** **:** Unleash hyper-fast response times to pull off high-speed city getaways, boosted by vibrant LIGHTSYNC RGB Lightbar that completely turns up the neon vibe!


- Set your LIGHTSYNC RGB in G HUB to this high-voltage twilight hex code #393cb9, blending into hot magenta #EE378F and sun-baked gold #FFB749, to instantly transform your desk into the iconic, sun-soaked sunset energy!


#### **High-Stakes Warfare**


Whether you’re blasting through the blockbuster campaign or sweating it out in the competitive multiplayer, upgrade your tactical loadout with tournament-ready gear built purely for speed, precision and staying ahead of the competition.


- **[PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/pro-x3-superstrike-mouse)** **:** Feel every shot with HITS technology, and customize your settings to enhance gameplay immersion so you can play faster.


- **[Astro A50 X:](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/a50-x-astro-wireless-headset)** Hear every step and crucial team callout with clarity—just don’t forget to check your corners!


- **[PRO X2 RAPID](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/pro-x2-rapid)** **:** Designed for rapid trigger functionality when split-second choices matter most, helping you execute sharp tactical plays and conquer tough campaign missions.


- Dial in #FCD237 hex code in G HUB to sync your LIGHTSYNC RGB lighting for a subtle golden accent that adds a touch of warmth to the heat of battle.


Regardless of what game you are looking forward to or what your playstyle is, there is something for everyone in the Logitech G lineup making it easier than ever to bring a little extra warmth, cozy vibes and shared excitement to your setup this holiday season.


*About the author: Julia works in communications at Logitech, passionate about gaming and eager for the future of Logitech G’s products.*
